high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Wired.com, viewed on a mobile device. The time displayed at the top of the screen is 8:04, and the device is connected to a 5G network with a partially charged battery. The content of the article discusses a graduation speech given by Steve Jobs. The text mentions that while graduation speeches are typically crafted to evoke laughter, Jobs' closest attempt at humor was when he mentioned how Windows copied the Mac's treatment of fonts.
